story: Operator navigation and historical/live analytics -> authenticated planning -> persistent dispatch -> driver lookup, directions and road/ferry map.
fixed: All28 public HLS sources now receive bounded metadata-only availability/recovery checks, independently of inference permission.
Availability source clocks expire on reads, delayed shutdowns can recover safely, and non-playlist/media responses are refused.
Operations summaries refresh independently before camera expiry; global road/ferry polling and upstream cache policies are preserved.
Alert acknowledgement belongs to the displayed observation rather than suppressing later observations with the same road ID.
Cached failed/partial ferry source checks preserve the original failure outcome.
Model status reports the actual serving-strategy metrics and scopes candidate scores separately.
Forecast evaluation summaries are read-only and support an isolated/persistent ledger path.
Complete provider snapshots do not depend on a warm forecasting model.
HTTP tests isolate camera/forecast/ferry stores and cannot accidentally launch production collectors.
The local API now runs detached from the launching tool session with private ignored logs.
